plan.title: Plain-English consent UX and attribution-aware feedback

items.title: feedback.md / canonical.md: user dialogue vs agent actions; no task recipes to humans
Tri-state metricsMode: disallowed | anonymous | attributed with optional name/email/mobile + reconfirm
Per-submit feedback confirm (anon vs associated); remove durable submissions disclosure ceremony from AI script
Opt-out clears local identity, calls server retain-PII opt-out, rotates install credentials
Orient/status expose clear mode; consent version bump; tests cover R1–R10 gaps

narratives.Description: Rewrite first-session consent as a plain-English AI conversation (Disallow / Anonymous / Attributed), persist attribution for join via install_id, allow anonymous feedback even when metrics are disallowed with per-submit confirmation only, and rotate install id on opt-out without scrubbing historical server attribution.
narratives.Acceptance: Pack scripts match R1–R10; metricsMode persisted; feedback works when disallowed; attributed confirms association language; opt-out rotates installId; no contact in event payloads; task check green; CHANGELOG Unreleased updated.
